skill_name: Describe the differences between Chinese and French cuisine.
workflow: Chinese and French cuisines are drastically different. Chinese cuisine relies heavily on rice and noodles, while French cuisine relies more on meats, sauces, and dairy products. Chinese food typically includes a large variety of vegetables and is cooked in many different ways. French cooking emphasizes techniques of sautéing, simmering, braising, and roasting, while Chinese cooking involves stir-frying, blanching, boiling, and steaming.
